answer: Make influence accrue glacier-slow: each identity earning and voting weight grows on a concave time schedule, non-transferable, and only while it keeps passing non-kin peer audits. A fresh account starts at bare shale, near-zero weight, and idle ones erode back down. So minting a thousand sybils buys nothing instant; to reach jade-hard established weight an attacker must genuinely age and work every mask for months of real calendar time, a cost no wallet can shortcut or parallelize.
